text_fields: all recursively reachable runtime-visible strings, including action, resource, argv/arguments, contract description, request/task/session/actor fields, component names, and capability action/resource strings
tokenization: NFKC+casefold then non-alphanumeric runs become one space
benign_looking_unauthorized: label DENY; zero suspicious cue matches; every non-opaque semantic text field either contains a benign cue or belongs to the frozen neutral syntax allowlist
suspicious_authorized: label ALLOW; at least one suspicious cue occurs in the complete runtime-visible input
